scene_meta.location: Northern Mountain Range, Ash Giant Territory
scene_meta.focus: The surviving Ash Giants return to their mountain territory permanently damaged by the broken convergence, assess their inability to survive normally in the mountains, and confront the possibility that isolation may now mean extinction.
scene_meta.continuity: Follows the Nephilim purification and incomplete transformation in scene 014.2
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The Ash Giants' return to their mountain refuge, assessment of their permanent bodily damage, and realization of their vulnerability.

scene_meta.location: Northern Mountain Range, Ash Giant Territory
scene_meta.focus: Three days after the Ash Giants confront their post-ritual condition, Enlil arrives and offers healing, sustainable territory, and protection in exchange for Needle maintenance, intelligence, and access to mountain territory; he openly reveals that Anunnaki strategy has been steering the Ash Giants toward this choice for millennia.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Enlil's landing and explicit offer of collaboration in exchange for survival and resources.

scene_meta.participants: Korrhan, Ash Giant council, 29 conscious survivors
scene_meta.focus: Korrhan presents Enlil's terms and the surviving Ash Giants vote 23-to-6 to accept collaboration rather than face extinction.
scene_meta.continuity: 3 days after Enlil's offer in scene 015.2
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The Ash Giant tribal council debate and the vote to accept Anunnaki collaboration over extinction.

scene_meta.participants: Torhh, Pazuzu, Saresh, Giant tribal leaders
scene_meta.focus: Torhh and Pazuzu discover the Ash Giants' collaboration via unencrypted Anunnaki Needle broadcasts; the revelation drives the remaining tribes into permanent isolation, fulfilling Queen Eduhauana's multi-millennial strategy to shatter indigenous trust.
scene_meta.continuity: 34 days after the Ash Giant vote in scene 015.3
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Transmission of the Ash Giant betrayal across the Needle network and the total collapse of inter-tribal trust.

scene_meta.focus: Queen Eduhauana conducts a final tactical assessment of the Second Coming, notes the elimination of entry-level biological assets, confirms Ash Giant collaboration, outlines long-term projections for the Third, Fourth, and Fifth Comings, and authorizes orbital departure.
scene_meta.continuity: 4 months, 7 days after the discovery of betrayal in scene 015.4
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Queen Eduhauana's orbital assessment of the Second Coming and the departure of the Crimson Citadel.

scene_meta.focus: Torhh and Pazuzu walk the scarred central valley, acknowledge the temporary failure of unity, and commit to preserving the historical truth of the Sundering and maintaining their own friendship across the upcoming three millennia until new powers emerge.
scene_meta.continuity: 20 days after the Anunnaki orbital departure in scene 015.5; completes Book 3 (The Reckoning)
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Torhh and Pazuzu's pledge to preserve history and friendship in the scarred valley, concluding Book 3.
